product: A portable React design system for products with a strong point of view and high visual voltage.
audience: Product teams, designers, and developers building expressive interfaces for focused desktop and responsive web use.

foundations.accentDirection: electric coral for action, with cyan reserved for focus cues
foundations.colorTemperature: cool night surfaces with warm coral and cream ink
foundations.contrast: high contrast with ink-bright text, visible lines, and crisp state changes
foundations.typographyCharacter: confident geometric grotesk with uppercase action labels and tight editorial hierarchy
foundations.dominantRadius: compact controls at 4px, with 8px and 14px used for grouped surfaces
foundations.surfaceModel: layered dark surfaces separated by muted planes and bright accent edges
foundations.borders: visible, deliberate borders in purple-gray line tones
foundations.elevation: physical offset shadows and restrained dark elevation rather than soft diffuse depth
foundations.motionIntensity: expressive 120–260ms transitions with physical easing, reduced for motion-sensitive users

components: dense form fields with labels, hints, and errors
layered menus and dialogs with keyboard-accessible states
